title: How to rob a bank (from the inside, that is) | William Black
summary: Former bank regulator William Black explains how fraud, including liar's loans, was committed from inside banks and drove the 2008 financial crisis.
why: Mentioned in threads about financial fraud as support for the claim that outright fraud, not just bad luck, caused the Great Recession.

quote.text: The far more significant cause of the Great Recession was outright fraud.
